summary: Proxy [[Delete]] in crates/kahvi-core/src/object/proxy/delete.rs now follows spec steps 1-14 in order. It calls validate_non_revoked with `?`, then get_method for "deleteProperty", and returns target.internal_delete when the trap is undefined. Otherwise it runs the trap via ops::call, applies to_boolean, and returns false on a false result. It then runs target.internal_get_own_property with `?`, returns true when the descriptor is absent, throws TypeError when configurable is Some(false), and checks is_extensible with `?`, throwing TypeError when the target is non-extensible. Ends with Ok(true). The not-implemented stub is gone for this method. No test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The removed NOTE comment and the removed allow(unused_imports) are cleanup tied to this change.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. Minor observations only: `let _ = o;` is an unused-parameter workaround, and the configurable check uses `== Some(false)` rather than a plain boolean test, which is fine for complete descriptors returned by [[GetOwnProperty]].
